items.title: 7.6 Digital Citizenship and Ethical Considerations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of digital citizenship (PDF 187-188).

blocks.title: Digital citizenship
blocks.text: Digital citizenship ka matlab digital technologies aur internet istemal karte waqt zimmedarana aur akhlaqi rawayya hai, khud aur doosron ko bachana, doosron ke huqooq ka ehtaram karna aur online duniya ko mehfooz aur sab ke liye bane rehne mein madad karna.
Students ko online izzat se baat karni, bullying, harassment aur ghalat maloomat se bachna, digital privacy ki qadar karni aur apne accounts mehfooz rakhne chahiyein.

blocks.prompt: Achhi digital citizenship ki do misalein dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Shaistagi se comment karna aur online kisi ko tang na karna, aur khabar share karne se pehle jaanchna.

items: Digital citizenship: online izzat, hifazat, diyanat aur privacy ka rawayya.
